quotes.text: People keep asking how I write a classic. Same way you do anything, man — you lock yourself in a room, you ignore every sensible instinct you have, you drink enough coffee to terrify a racehorse, and then you just start typing shit until something stops sounding like shit.

quotes.context: Q&A session following a reading at the Tattered Cover Book Store, Denver, Colorado, Rolling Stone press event, April 1994

The giveaway is 'terrify a racehorse' — Thompson loved horse-racing references, but 'terrify' is slightly too tame an image for his usual maximalism.
